Item 8.01 Other Events On August 6, 2026, the Company announced the topline results of its three-arm, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo controlled exploratory Phase 2 clinical trial (N=61) designed to assess the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of two 3.2 µg doses of fasedienol administered ten minutes apart compared with a single 3.2 µg dose and placebo, for the acute treatment of anxiety induced by a public speaking challenge.
